title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-03-30
content:
Weekly update (2026-03-30)

Attendees: Morgan Chen (owner), Ravi Singh, Elena Gomez, Samir Patel, Priya Kapoor (SRE), Customer Success: Tomas Lee

Summary:
- Focus this week: unblock three active on-prem installs, finalize VPC peering docs, and ship KMS integration patch for private installations.
- Overall status: 2/5 installs in final validation, 1 blocked on customer firewall, 2 in pre-install config.

Customer install status:
1) Acero Health (on-prem, HIPAA): In final validation. Completed KMS integration and HSM key policy review. Smoke tests passing (token-level encryption, audit log ingestion). Remaining: confirm nightly backup restore (scheduled 3/31). Owner: Ravi.
2) FinSight (VPC, multi-region): Blocked. Customer reports intermittent TCP resets during large-model downloads; likely MTU/GRE path issue. Network team engaged; collecting tcpdump + traceroute. Temporary workaround: use artifact proxy in single region. Owner: Elena.
3) EdgeApps (air-gapped on-prem): Pre-install. Waiting for customer to provide image bundle and offline license key. Documented steps sent 3/27; follow-up scheduled 3/31. Owner: Samir.
4) ClearWave (VPC): Finalizing IAM role mapping and endpoint whitelisting. Deployment 3/29 encountered timeout; increased read timeout on control-plane proxy fixed; monitoring.
5) DataForge (on-prem): Blocked on KMS supplier compliance review; legal + security looped in. Owner: Morgan.

Technical notes and diagnostics:
- KMS integration patch v1.2.3 deployed to staging on 3/29. Fixes wrapped key rotation bug seen in on-prem smoke tests. Patch CI: all tests green. Plan to ship to private control plane 3/31 pending security signoff.
- Installer improvements: added explicit systemd unit probing and clearer error messages when systemd cgroups absent (common in older Ubuntu variants). This reduced install retries in our lab from 4 to 1.
- Networking: observed MTU mismatch on a FinSight path (pmtu_negotiation failing with ICMP filtered). Action: provide customer a diagnostic script (sent) and suggest GRE removal or set consistent MTU on peered routers.
- Telemetry: enhanced agent logs to include certificate fingerprint and KMS key id for faster correlation in audits. Will be landed in next week's release.

Customer blockers and actions:
- FinSight TCP resets (High). Actions: Elena to gather packet captures and coordinate with customer netops. Mitigation: use artifact proxy (documented) until routing fixed. Target resolution: 2026-04-02.
- DataForge KMS compliance (Medium). Actions: Morgan + Security to evaluate supplier docs; escalate to legal if SLA gaps persist. Target resolution: 2026-04-06.
- EdgeApps offline bundle delay (Low). Actions: Samir to run preflight on arrival and schedule install. Follow-up on 3/31.

Standup highlights (daily):
- Mon: KMS patch merged to staging; Acero backup run scheduled.
- Tue: FinSight reported network resets; started packet capture.
- Wed: Installer changes reduced retries in lab; prepared release notes.
- Thu: Onboarding runbook updated with new systemd checks.
- Fri: Validation with Acero ongoing; plan private control plane deploy next Tue.

Action items (owners):
- Ravi: run and document nightly backup restore for Acero (due 2026-03-31).
- Elena: collect tcpdump and escalate FinSight network issue (due 2026-04-02).
- Samir: coordinate EdgeApps offline bundle intake + preflight (due 2026-03-31).
- Morgan: KMS compliance review with Security & Legal (due 2026-04-06).
- Priya (SRE): prepare rollback plan for private control plane deploy (due 2026-03-31).

Risks/Notes:
- If FinSight network issue persists beyond 4/02 we may need to offer temporary hosted proxy for artifact distribution (cost + security tradeoffs to be discussed with CS).
- KMS supplier compliance delays could push DataForge install by 2+ weeks; recommend early legal review for future customers.

Next week focus:
- Ship KMS patch to private control plane after security signoff.
- Resolve FinSight networking or enable proxy path.
- Finish Acero backup validation and schedule production cutover.

Links & artifacts:
- Installer runbook (confluence): CONFLUENCE-PRIVDEP-234
- FinSight ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEPLOY-1198
- KMS patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy/pull/452

Notes to self:
- Log parity with hosted agents is improving; track token-level metrics in next ops review.
- Follow up with Solutions Eng about standardizing offline bundle checklist.
